_meta.note: Curated model debut dates (YYYY-MM-DD, first public availability). Source of truth for the offline trendsetter badge: a model counts as 'adopted in its debut week' when the ledger's first use falls within 7 days of this date. Only add dates verified against a vendor announcement; models absent from this file fall back to the local floor (distinct models), so tiers can never downgrade.
_meta.codenamePolicy: Internal codenames with no public announcement (dfmodel/gfmodel/mmodel, hy4-preview, space-bunny, ...) get their debut from first local use, per owner decision 2026-10-23 — they are already covered by the distinct-model floor.
